packageRules.description: linuxserver.io images (linuxserver/* and lscr.io/linuxserver/*) use non-semver tags: `X.Y.Z` (e.g. 10.11.11), `X.Y[.Z]ubuNNNN[-lsN]` (e.g. 12.1ubu2604-ls50), or 4-component `X.Y.Z.B-lsN` (e.g. 4.0.19.2979-ls324). The default `docker` versioning can't rank across these formats, so use an explicit regex versioning that accepts both stable shapes. Dev/nightly tags (2.6.4-develop, 2.6.5-nightly, etc.) don't match this pattern and are therefore ignored — only stable releases are tracked.
